task: Independently mark every visible passage over the full trace, including explicit absence and uncertainty.

coordinate_system.note: Retain integer bounds unchanged; matching conventions are specified separately.

defaults_policy: Only a user-drawn interval creates an event. No automatic interval, trace verdict, or expected event count. Defaulted fields remain flagged until changed.
completion: Every manifest trace requires an explicit completed decision; no events plus interpretable requires empty_confirmed. Uncertain/unusable traces are never silently coded as negative.
finalization: A complete export is a checksummed immutable snapshot; the local working copy remains editable for corrections and a new export.
persistence: Local browser autosave plus downloadable JSON backups; final JSON is collected and archived byte-for-byte.
identity: Automatic local random session identifier. Coordinator associates sender identity on receipt; no identity prompt in the annotation tool.
